newsitem.title: USA: Storage Trust arranges $100 mln financing.
newsitem.headline: Storage Trust arranges $100 mln financing.

text.p: Storage Trust Realty said it arranged a $100 million private debt placement by its operating subsidiary, Storage Trust Properties LP.
This subsidiary funded $75 million of the financing on Wednesday. The remaining $25 million is expected to be funded April 15.
The fixed-rate, unsecured debt has a weighted average interest rate of 7.58 percent a year and a weighted average maturity of 7.12 years. It will be issued in two series.
Proceeds of the financing will be used to repay debt under the company's revolving line of credit and to finance additional self-storage acquisitions.
Storage Trust Realty is a real estate investment trust.
